title: National Career Service — Pan-India Job Search Portal
description: Official Ministry of Labour & Employment portal to search and apply for verified private and public sector job openings, career fairs, and state employment exchanges across India.
provider_name: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India

eligibility.notes: Open across qualification levels (10th pass to postgraduate); candidates register with Aadhaar/NCS ID.

provenance_notes: Official portal search directory link for NCS jobseeker services. Represents a trusted search directory, not an individual job vacancy.

title: Apprenticeship India — Designated Trade Opportunity Directory
description: Official national directory to discover industry apprenticeships with registered enterprises under the Apprentices Act and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS).
provider_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NAPS

eligibility.notes: Candidates with ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Vocational qualifications in designated trades.

provenance_notes: Official directory destination for searching active enterprise apprenticeships across states.

title: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Official Portal
description: Central government application portal for candidates applying to 12-month corporate internships in top 500 partner enterprises under Ministry of Corporate Affairs guidelines.
provider_name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

eligibility.qualification: Passed 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Graduate degree.

provenance_notes: Central government internship portal search destination. Stipend details apply to specific matched company listings under the scheme.

title: Skill India Digital Hub — Free Courses Directory
description: Explore all officially listed free online vocational, technological, and foundational courses certified by NSDC.
provider_name: NSDC / Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
provenance_notes: Official search directory destination for NSDC zero-cost online courses.

title: SWAYAM — Course Search & Enrolment Directory
description: Explore national higher education and engineering courses delivered by IITs, IIMs, and central universities with academic credit transfer options.
provider_name: Ministry of Education, Government of India

eligibility.notes: Open enrolment; academic credits require registered proctored examination.

provenance_notes: National MOOC directory search link. All course contents are free to audit.

title: Unlocking AI for Everyone (Beginner)
description: Foundational 45-minute self-paced module on core artificial intelligence concepts, responsible AI practices, and everyday productivity use-cases.

eligibility.target_audience: Beginners exploring AI and digital tools.

provenance_notes: Verified individual listing on SIDH. Delivered by Microsoft. Confirmed free of cost with self-paced 45-minute duration.

title: Generative AI — Applied Industry Certification
description: Comprehensive industry skilling program featuring 60 hours of theory and 30 hours of practical laboratory learning covering prompt engineering, LLM architectures, and AI application development.

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic programming fundamentals (Python recommended) and understanding of web data structures.

provenance_notes: Verified partner program on SWAYAM Plus portal. Commercial provider SmartBridge; verified fee of ₹5,999 for 90 learning hours. Not a free government course.

title: Database Management System (DBMS) — NPTEL
description: In-depth computer science curriculum covering relational algebra, standard SQL (DDL/DML), schema normalization, indexing, transaction processing, and concurrency control.

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic data structures and discrete mathematics.

provenance_notes: NPTEL/IIT Kharagpur official course on SWAYAM. Course auditing and study materials are 100% free; optional proctored exam has a nominal fee.

title: Frontend Web Development: Modern UI and Component Architecture
description: Hands-on foundation course covering HTML5 semantic markup, CSS3 responsive layout, modern ES6+ JavaScript, and component-based UI engineering with React.
provider_name: Skill India Digital Hub Partner Skilling

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and logical problem solving.

provenance_notes: Self-paced frontend engineering curriculum listed on Skill India Digital Hub.

title: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Official Scheme Listing
description: 12-month experiential learning opportunity with top 500 corporate establishments across India, offering ₹5,000 monthly stipend co-funded by Central Government and CSR partners, plus a ₹6,000 one-time contingency grant.
provider_name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

eligibility.qualification: Passed 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Graduate (BA, BSc, BCom, BCA, BBA, BPharma).
eligibility.exclusions: Graduates from IITs, IIMs, IISERs, CA/CMA, or family member employed in permanent government service are not eligible.

provenance_notes: Officially notified Government scheme under MCA guidelines. Specific verified criteria published on pminternship.mca.gov.in.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme: Electronics & Instrumentation Testing
description: Government-registered apprenticeship standard for testing, calibration, and assembly of electronic instrumentation under NAPS guidelines with direct benefit transfer (DBT) stipend support.

eligibility.min_education: ITI in Electronics Mechanic / Diploma in Electronics Engineering

provenance_notes: Standardized curriculum specifications from MSDE Apprenticeship Training Scheme.
